verdict.rationale: Namecheap exposes an API endpoint with a sandbox, and its official Terraform provider manages DNS configuration with one resource per record, which implies programmatic create, update and delete of records. A dynamic-DNS HTTPS update method also exists. However, the pack never shows the raw API's DNS record methods or their documentation, and the Go SDK excerpts cover only domain registration, renewal and lock operations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of DNS record create/update/delete API endpoints, evidence of individual record update/delete (rather than whole-zone replacement) at the API level, any mention of ACME/TXT challenge automation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
